This template can be used to create a category intersection link for two different categories.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and replace <code>''category1''</code> and <code>''category2''</code> with the desired categories.

<code><nowiki>{{Catintersect|</nowiki>''category1''|''category2''<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>

===Pre-requisite(s)===
Category intersection feature needs to be enabled through [[Special:Preferences|Preferences]] → [[Special:Preferences#mw-prefsection-gadgets|Gadgets]] → ''Enable the category intersection tool''.

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Catintersect|Humans|Canon articles}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Catintersect|Humans|Canon articles}}
<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Catintersect|Images of Anakin Skywalker|Images of Padmé Amidala}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Catintersect|Images of Anakin Skywalker|Images of Padmé Amidala}}
